latest.title: What I Learned While Building My First Cloud-Based Application

latest.title: What Is AWS? A Beginner’s Guide to Amazon Web Services
latest.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most widely used cloud platform. Instead of buying and maintaining your own servers, you rent computing power, storage, and tools from Amazon’s data centers and pay only for what you use. Startups, banks, game studios, and government agencies all run on it.

latest.title: AWS Security Groups vs Network ACLs: Key Differences
latest.description: Learn how AWS Security Groups and Network Access Control Lists (NACLs) protect cloud resources. Explore stateful vs stateless traffic filtering, inbound and outbound rules, and practical examples for securing Amazon EC2 instances.

latest.title: Your AI Agent Can Suggest a Refund. Should It Be Allowed to Execute It?
latest.description: Build an interactive, local-first tool-call approval gate for Amazon Bedrock. Edit JSON, test customer isolation and amount limits, and see why a valid proposal still needs human review. Complete Python code, adversarial tests, and an optional Converse adapter included.

latest.title: How I Built an Automated AI + IoT System on AWS for Under $1 (Without Breaking the Free Tier)

latest.title: Recap: My Talk at AWS Community Day Shenzhen 🤗
latest.description: A recap of my talk at AWS Community Day Shenzhen 2026! This year's event brought together Amazon CTO Werner Vogels, AWS community leaders, and 30+ technical experts for great talks and hands-on workshops. I joined AWS experts to share how AWS Frontier Agents, including AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Continuum, can help companies going global improve cloud security, streamline operations, and manage continuous compliance across the entire software lifecycle. Thanks to everyone who made this event a success!

trending.title: Strands Decider 2B, hosted: 1.6 million tokens served to 100+ builders, 2,000 free decisions a month, and a zero-downtime fix on air
trending.description: AWS User Group Madurai turned the open Strands Decider 2B model into an API you call like any LLM provider, with a free tier, no token bill and about 0.68 s per decision on CPU. I cover how I built it, how we scaled it during our live session, and the kit for the Agent Experience Hackathon.

trending.title: El Community Day más grande que he visto este 2026 fue en Guatemala
trending.description: El AWS Community Day más grande al que he asistido este 2026: más de 2.400 registrados, 1.300 asistentes y todas las salas llenas. Cuento la Casa de Kiro, la marimba en vivo, caminar el centro histórico comiendo comida típica, y por qué la amabilidad guatemalteca y una organización impecable me dejaron con ganas de volver por tercera vez.

trending.title: Let's Strands Decider our Role-Playing Game
trending.description:
If you build agents that call tools, you can let them act when they're sure and ask when they're not.
That is the job Strands Decider does. It is a small decision model that answers a typed question (yes/no, pick one, or a score) in a few hundred milliseconds on a laptop.
